name: Planning Center
shortDescription: A suite of connected church products with a free people database and free usage tiers published across its product range.
suitableContexts: Churches that want to adopt separate church operations products gradually

pricing.summary: People is free and the supplier documents free capacity-limited tiers for its other products; paid limits vary by product.

startingPrice.qualifier: Free product tiers; paid costs vary by product and usage

editorial.assessment: Planning Center can be explored with free tiers and expanded product by product. UK churches should verify Gift Aid workflows, payment availability, currency, contracts and data-processing details before shortlisting it.
bestFor: Churches that want a modular product suite
Teams that need volunteer scheduling and service planning
strengths: The People database is documented as free without a profile limit
Every product has a capacity-limited free tier
limitations: No UK-specific Gift Aid support has been confirmed in this review
A multi-product setup requires careful total-cost and workflow assessment

seo.title: Planning Center: UK church software profile
seo.description: Independent Planning Center profile covering free tiers, service planning and church management, plus UK-specific questions still to verify.
